page.title: File -> Save As
page.introduction: This section describes the File->Save As menu option. The Save As menu option allows the user to save a new VCell document - BioModel or MathModel. The operation allows a document/model that has already been saved to be saved as a different model, and a new model to be saved in the database for the first time.

operations.para: Clicking on File->Save As (Cmd+Shift+S on macOS, Ctrl+Shift+S on Windows and Linux) opens the Save As dialog. Its Name field starts with the model's current name, selected, so typing replaces it.

Below the field, Similarly named BioModels (or MathModels, or Geometries) lists your own models of that type whose names are related to what you've typed: names containing it, and names it contains (typing "FRAP model 2" lists "FRAP model"). Before you type, it lists them all. Click a name, or select it and press Enter, to copy it into the field and build on it (e.g., adding "_v2"). The Down arrow moves from the field into the list.
